session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Always in Long, Bull Trend Continued up to Resistance'; day-type note 'Bull trend continuation from yesterday up to top of 4-day broad trading range'. Reading: parabolic opening wedge to 6765 with a shallow pullback, double bottom 6735/6740 (shaded morning range 6766-6740 with red-dotted double top), High 1 pullback after a failed breakout, then a bull trend of higher lows through 6775 resistance to 6780, finishing in a tight trading range into the close at 4-day-trading-range resistance (close 6772 below the 6785 range top). Axis ET+12 hrs (22:00-04:00 printed; Oct 24 edge marker) - offset suspicion. Inset daily panel: 'Market Still in Broad Trading Range'. Bar numbers 12-72 printed.
